dataset_title: DrugRev: A comprehensive customers reviews on drugs purchasing and satisfaction
domain: Clinical Pharmacology, Pharmacovigilance, and Patient Satisfaction Analysis
target_users: Clinical researchers, pharmacists, prescribing physicians, and healthcare consumers

schema_fields.name: MedicineName
schema_fields.description: Brand or generic drug name evaluated

schema_fields.name: ReviewLength
schema_fields.description: Length of customer review in characters

schema_fields.name: Reviews
schema_fields.description: Full narrative text of patient experience

quality_issues_and_remediation.fix: Trimmed leading and trailing whitespace across all drug strings
Standardized non-duration string entries to 'Not Specified'
Applied clinical rule-based keyword extraction for 27 standardized ADRs

sampling_strategy: Stratified balanced sampling across top 10 therapeutic conditions ensuring >=30 reviews per drug-condition pair for rich multi-hop graph connectivity while adhering to Neo4j Aura Free tier node limits.
